import json,subprocess
import numpy as np
from faster_whisper import WhisperModel
raw=subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-v','error','-i','input/request.mp4','-vn','-ar','16000','-ac','1','-f','f32le','-'],capture_output=True,check=True).stdout
audio=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype=np.float32)
model=WhisperModel('large-v3',device='cpu',compute_type='int8',cpu_threads=8)
allseg=[]
for start,end in [(0,20),(29,56),(60,64),(79,85),(96,107),(112,123),(128,145),(151,175),(183,206),(209,224),(227,243.2)]:
 segments,info=model.transcribe(audio[int(start*16000):int(end*16000)],language='zh',vad_filter=False,word_timestamps=True,condition_on_previous_text=False)
 for s in segments:
  row={'s':s.start+start,'e':s.end+start,'text':s.text,'words':[{'w':w.word,'s':w.start+start,'e':w.end+start} for w in s.words]}
  allseg.append(row)
  print(json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
Path=None
open('work/asr_chunks.json','w',encoding='utf8').write(json.dumps(allseg,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
